Package com.rca.student.service

Class StudentService

java.lang.Object
com.rca.student.service.StudentService
public class StudentService extends Object
Provides services for managing students in the system

This class handles operations such as adding,finding,removing and listing student(s). All methods that attempt to find student by Id or email throw StudentNotFoundException if no matching student is found.

Since:
1.0
